fields.FIR_Description: As per the complaint recorded on 2025-01-31, a document allegedly prepared using forged details of the complainant was used to seek a payment of Rs. 5,00,000. The time of the incident was given as 17:10 on 2025-01-16. Suspicion was reportedly directed towards Prakash Palanisamy, using the number 9000000156. No independent witness was identified at the time of registration. Items referenced in the complaint: physical documents and digital documents.
